findings.title: Visual navigation bypasses unsupported text
findings.message: In a layout containing both supported horizontal runs and unsupported vertical/math runs, Move can jump over unsupported text or return the unchanged caret when the adjacent line has no interaction carets. It still reports success, so cursorVisual never invokes its logical-grapheme fallback. Arrow navigation can therefore skip characters or become stuck before an unsupported line.
findings.suggestion: Track unsupported source ranges and lines in the interaction geometry. Have Move report failure when a transition would cross unsupported content, and use the existing logical-grapheme fallback for that transition. Add mixed supported/unsupported horizontal-arrow tests.

findings.title: Unsupported runs are excluded from the scroll extent
findings.message: The scroll extent is derived exclusively from interaction cells, but vertical/math runs deliberately produce no cells. For an unsupported layout, advance remains zero and every scroll request is reset to zero; in a mixed layout, an unsupported trailing run is excluded from the extent. Although caret positioning falls back to legacy geometry, the caret cannot be scrolled into view.
findings.suggestion: Include the rendered extent or accumulated advances of unsupported runs when calculating the maximum horizontal scroll. Add tests for an overflowing math run and for a supported run followed by unsupported content.
